repeatmodeler.reason_ltrstruct_false: The installed environment has not qualified the optional LTR structural dependency chain across the full panel. Core RepeatModeler discovery remains the complete primary full-panel run; any LTR structural sensitivity requires its own source-bound, resource-qualified execution.

restart_policy: A completed receipt with matching source SHA-256 is reused. RepeatModeler -recoverDir is used only after more than one completed round because RepeatModeler rejects early-round recovery. Earlier interrupted RM_* directories are preserved under an interrupted_ prefix and restarted from the verified source. Source FASTA remains in an incomplete work directory and is recreated from the verified compressed source when absent. If RepeatModeler finishes discovery but its embedded classifier does not create a classified library, the controller invokes RepeatClassifier directly against the completed consensus using the pinned FamDB installation.
scope: All 526 manifest taxa are retained. This configuration prepares de-novo repeat-library discovery and produces no biological association result.
